R01.reviewer_reason: PAN name does not match business name
R01.plain_language_meaning: The name on the PAN card is different from the business name entered.
R01.standard_fix: Upload the PAN of the business (or proprietor) whose name matches the application, or correct the business name to match the PAN.

R02.plain_language_meaning: GSTIN is wrong, inactive, or belongs to a different legal name or address.
R02.standard_fix: Enter the correct GSTIN, or upload a current GST certificate that matches the legal name and address.

R03.plain_language_meaning: The bank account holder name differs from the business or PAN name.
R03.standard_fix: Use a current account in the business name (or proprietor's name for proprietorships), or upload a bank letter / cancelled cheque showing the matching name.

R04.plain_language_meaning: Account number or IFSC is wrong, or the account is inactive, so the Re 1 test credit failed.
R04.standard_fix: Re-enter the account number and IFSC carefully; check the account is active and can receive credits.

R05.plain_language_meaning: The uploaded image or PDF is blurred, cropped, or password-protected.
R05.standard_fix: Re-upload a clear, full-page colour scan in PDF/JPG/PNG under 5 MB.

R06.plain_language_meaning: Website or app lacks Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Refund/Cancellation Policy or Contact details.
R06.standard_fix: Add all four pages with working links and resubmit the website URL.

R07.plain_language_meaning: Website is down, under construction, or needs a login to view products and prices.
R07.standard_fix: Make the website publicly accessible with products, prices and contact details visible, then resubmit.

R08.plain_language_meaning: No address proof, or the proof is older than 3 months or shows a different address.
R08.standard_fix: Upload a recent utility bill, rent agreement or other valid address proof matching the application address.

R09.plain_language_meaning: Authorised signatory or director ID is missing, or the details don't match the application.
R09.standard_fix: Upload a valid ID of the authorised signatory and ensure the name and DOB match the application.

R10.plain_language_meaning: The business sells products or services we cannot support (for example gambling or prohibited goods).
R10.standard_fix: Cannot be fixed. Politely close the application; do not suggest workarounds.

R11.plain_language_meaning: The business category selected differs from what the website actually sells.
R11.standard_fix: Select the correct category, or share a short note and evidence explaining the business model, for a second review.

R12.plain_language_meaning: The application matched a negative or sanctions list during screening.
R12.standard_fix: Do not discuss the reason with the applicant. Route to the Compliance team and tell the applicant it is under review.

R13.plain_language_meaning: No rejection. The applicant started the application but stopped without finishing.
R13.standard_fix: Send a friendly reminder naming the exact step they stopped at, with a direct link to resume.
